description: Keyword search over model and dataset records with task, license and format filters, when you have no exact name. Returns ids and short summaries; detail=full adds the full record. Example: {"q":"embedding","limit":5}.

q.description: Text such as qwen coder 7b or an owner/repo.

task.description: Exact task label, or code, chat, pictures. For broad needs such as reranking use q alone.

type.description: Such as llm, embedding or dataset.

name: search_artifacts
title: Search the catalog
